stage1.ineligibility_reason: Industrial-assessment case report: two example energy audits (a container-glass manufacturing operation and a distribution centre) producing lists of energy-saving recommendations. It does not present, propose, evaluate, or critique an EnPI/EnB measurement model with identifiable variables, functional form, or construction/estimation approach (v2.3 threshold). Benchmarking against industry average/theoretical minimums and a heat/mass balance (Fig.2, figure-only) are mentioned incidentally and never characterised; ISO 50001 is cited only as management strategy.

HUMAN/FN-CENSUS: Case 1 is container-glass manufacturing with melting furnaces (a continuous-process sector), so this paper hits the continuous-process lexicon; flagged so the FN census reviews it despite the ineligible call.
